caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, golden broth, topped with tender chashu, a pink naruto fish cake, and vibrant green scallions. Served in a white bowl with red trim, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and a glistening surface from broth.
The shio (salt) broth is clear golden, holding thin noodles, bean sprouts, and green onions in a gentle, swirling motion.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red rim, smooth surface, slightly glossy finish, and faint speckles visible.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl center, white outer layer, scalloped edge, smooth surface with subtle texture.
